road_trips.name: Route 66
road_trips.summary: America's 'Main Street': diners, neon signs and desert landscapes from Chicago to the Pacific.
road_trips.tip: Parts of the original road are patchy, so use a Historic Route 66 map.

road_trips.name: Pacific Coast Highway (Highway 1)
road_trips.summary: Sheer cliffs, redwoods and beaches along the California coast.
road_trips.tip: Landslides sometimes close stretches near Big Sur; check Caltrans before you go.

road_trips.name: Blue Ridge Parkway
road_trips.summary: A slow, scenic ridge-top road through the Appalachian Mountains with no commercial traffic.
road_trips.tip: Speed limits are low and fog is common; some sections close in winter.

road_trips.name: Overseas Highway to Key West
road_trips.summary: A causeway road hopping across the Florida Keys over dozens of bridges.
highlights: John Pennekamp Coral Reef State Park
road_trips.tip: Hurricane season runs June to November; expect heavy weekend traffic.

road_trips.name: Going-to-the-Sun Road
road_trips.summary: An engineering marvel climbing across the Continental Divide in Glacier National Park.
road_trips.tip: Snow closes the high section until summer; there are vehicle size limits and timed-entry rules, so check the park.

road_trips.name: Road to Hana
road_trips.summary: A jungle road on Maui with hundreds of curves, one-lane bridges and waterfalls.
road_trips.tip: Start early, let locals pass and check your rental contract for road restrictions.

road_trips.name: Beartooth Highway
road_trips.summary: A high alpine road to nearly 3,300 metres, a famous approach to Yellowstone.
road_trips.tip: Closed by snow for much of the year; weather changes fast.

road_trips.name: Oregon Coast Highway (US-101)
road_trips.summary: Sea stacks, lighthouses and sand dunes along the whole Oregon coast.
road_trips.tip: Pack layers; fog and wind are common even in summer.

road_trips.name: Natchez Trace Parkway
road_trips.summary: A quiet parkway that follows an ancient trail used by Native Americans and early travellers.
road_trips.tip: Commercial vehicles are banned and services are sparse, so fill up in towns.

road_trips.name: Million Dollar Highway
road_trips.summary: A white-knuckle section of US-550 with steep drops and no guardrails.
road_trips.tip: Take care in snow and storms; not recommended for nervous drivers.

road_trips.name: Dalton Highway
road_trips.summary: A rugged gravel haul road across the Arctic to the Prudhoe Bay oil fields.
road_trips.tip: Services are very far apart; carry spare tyres, food and fuel.

road_trips.name: Alaska Highway
road_trips.summary: A wartime road through northern wilderness with wildlife around every bend.
road_trips.tip: Fuel and lodging are limited; watch for bison and moose on the road.

road_trips.name: Icefields Parkway
road_trips.summary: One of the world's great mountain drives between Banff and Jasper National Parks.
road_trips.tip: A national park pass is needed; use winter tyres in cold months.

road_trips.name: Cabot Trail
road_trips.summary: A loop around Cape Breton Island with ocean cliffs and highland scenery.
road_trips.tip: Moose cross the road at dusk; autumn weekends are busy.

road_trips.name: Trans-Canada Highway
road_trips.summary: Coast to coast across the world's second-largest country, with two ferry hops.
road_trips.tip: The route includes ferries at both ends; allow weeks and watch for winter storms.

road_trips.name: Sea to Sky Highway
road_trips.summary: A fjord-side road climbing from Vancouver to the mountains of Whistler.
road_trips.tip: Winter tyres are required on many highways from October to April.

road_trips.name: Viking Trail (Newfoundland)
road_trips.summary: A road to the northern tip of Newfoundland, ending at a real Viking settlement.
road_trips.tip: Services are sparse, so refuel often; icebergs are best seen in spring.

road_trips.name: Gaspé Peninsula Loop
road_trips.summary: A coastal loop around the Gaspé Peninsula with fishing villages and sea cliffs.
road_trips.tip: Book accommodation early in July and August.

road_trips.name: Pan-American Highway
road_trips.summary: One of the longest roads on Earth, from the Arctic to the tip of South America.
road_trips.tip: There is a gap with no road at the Darien Gap between Panama and Colombia, so vehicles are shipped around it.

road_trips.name: Baja California Highway 1
road_trips.summary: A long peninsula road between desert, mountains and two seas, ending at the tip of Baja.
road_trips.tip: Fuel stops can be far apart; avoid driving at night because of cattle and potholes.

road_trips.name: Ruta Maya: Cancun to Tikal
road_trips.summary: A tour of Maya cities and Caribbean coast across three countries.
road_trips.tip: You cross two international borders, so check vehicle and entry rules.

road_trips.name: Costa Rica Volcano and Cloud Forest Loop
road_trips.summary: Volcanoes, hot springs, cloud forests and a Pacific beach in one small country.
road_trips.tip: Mountain roads are slow in the rainy season.

road_trips.name: Ruta 40
road_trips.summary: Argentina's legendary highway along the Andes from the north to the far south.
road_trips.tip: Long gravel sections and strong Patagonian winds; fuel and tyres need planning.

road_trips.name: Carretera Austral
road_trips.summary: A remote Patagonian road through fjords, glaciers and temperate rainforest.
road_trips.tip: Mostly gravel, and some links need ferries; book ahead in summer.

road_trips.name: Salar de Uyuni and the Southwest Circuit
road_trips.summary: A 4x4 journey across the world's largest salt flat and colourful high-altitude lagoons.
road_trips.tip: Go with a guide and a good vehicle; altitudes are above 4,000 metres.

road_trips.name: North Yungas Road (Death Road)
road_trips.summary: A dramatic descent from the Andes into the Amazon valleys, now popular for guided cycling.
road_trips.tip: Use a reputable operator; the road is narrow with steep drops.

road_trips.name: Route of the Seven Lakes
road_trips.summary: A short lakeside road through Patagonian forests, lakes and mountains.
road_trips.tip: Part of the road is gravel; stop at the miradores for views.

road_trips.name: Salta to Cafayate (Ruta 68)
road_trips.summary: Red rock canyons and high-altitude vineyards in northwest Argentina.
road_trips.tip: Flash floods can close roads in the summer rains.

road_trips.name: Southern Peru: Lima to Cusco
road_trips.summary: The classic route past desert coast, ancient lines, volcano-ringed Arequipa and the Inca capital.
road_trips.tip: Altitude rises quickly; allow time to acclimatise in Cusco.

road_trips.name: Avenue of the Volcanoes
road_trips.summary: A highland road lined with snow-capped volcanoes, markets and thermal baths.
road_trips.tip: Altitude is high and mountain weather changes fast.

road_trips.name: Rio-Santos Coastal Road
road_trips.summary: Rainforest-covered mountains meeting beaches and colonial towns on the Costa Verde.
road_trips.tip: Holiday weekends bring heavy traffic; bring insect repellent for the beaches.

road_trips.name: Uruguay's Atlantic Coast
road_trips.summary: Dunes, lighthouses and beach towns along the Rocha coast.
road_trips.tip: Cabo Polonio is reached on foot or by 4x4 across the dunes.

road_trips.name: Iceland Ring Road (Route 1)
road_trips.best_time: June to August; December to February for aurora
road_trips.summary: A circuit of the whole island with glaciers, waterfalls, volcanoes and black sand beaches.
road_trips.tip: Winter storms close roads; gravel F-roads need 4x4 vehicles and are for summer only.

road_trips.name: North Coast 500
road_trips.summary: Scotland's answer to Route 66: castles, beaches and dramatic Highland roads.
road_trips.tip: Many single-track roads, so use passing places and book lodging early.

road_trips.name: Wild Atlantic Way
road_trips.summary: One of the world's longest coastal routes, following Ireland's rugged west coast.
road_trips.tip: Roads are narrow and weather changes quickly; allow extra time.

road_trips.name: Ring of Kerry
road_trips.summary: A loop around the Iveragh Peninsula with lakes, mountains and ocean views.
road_trips.tip: Tour buses travel counter-clockwise, so drive the same direction to avoid squeezes.

road_trips.name: Causeway Coastal Route
road_trips.summary: A dramatic coast road in Northern Ireland, famous for its filming locations.
road_trips.tip: Book timed tickets for popular sites in summer.

road_trips.name: Route des Grandes Alpes
road_trips.summary: A high-mountain drive crossing 16 passes from Lake Geneva to the Mediterranean.
road_trips.tip: Most passes are closed by snow from about October to May.

road_trips.name: Romantic Road
road_trips.summary: A route through half-timbered towns and fairy-tale castles in southern Germany.
road_trips.tip: Neuschwanstein tickets sell out in summer, so reserve ahead.

road_trips.name: Black Forest High Road
road_trips.summary: A ridge road through dark forests with views over the Rhine plain.
road_trips.tip: Snow may close the road in winter.

road_trips.name: Amalfi Coast Road (SS163)
road_trips.summary: Cliffside hairpins above the sea, through lemon groves and pastel villages.
road_trips.tip: The road is very narrow with heavy bus traffic, so avoid July and August.

road_trips.name: Great Dolomites Road
road_trips.summary: Jagged limestone peaks and high passes in the Italian Alps.
road_trips.tip: Passes close in winter; mountain weather can change quickly.

road_trips.name: Tuscany: Chianti to Val d'Orcia
road_trips.best_time: April to June; September to October
road_trips.summary: Cypress-lined roads through vineyards, hill towns and rolling farmland.
road_trips.tip: Avoid city centres with restricted driving zones (ZTL).

road_trips.name: Grossglockner High Alpine Road
road_trips.summary: Austria's highest paved mountain road, climbing to 2,500 metres.
road_trips.tip: A toll applies and the road is closed in winter.

road_trips.name: Transfagarasan
road_trips.summary: A winding mountain road across the Carpathians with hairpin after hairpin.
road_trips.tip: Open only in summer; closed from about October to June.

road_trips.name: Transalpina (DN67C)
road_trips.summary: Romania's highest road, crossing the Parang Mountains at over 2,100 metres.
road_trips.tip: Closed to traffic by snow in winter.

road_trips.name: Croatia's Adriatic Highway (D8)
road_trips.summary: A road down the Dalmatian coast between limestone cliffs and the blue Adriatic.
road_trips.tip: Summer traffic and ferry queues are heavy.

road_trips.name: Grand Tour of Switzerland
road_trips.summary: A circuit through lakes, Alpine passes and mountain resorts.
road_trips.tip: A motorway vignette is needed; high passes close in winter.

road_trips.name: Atlantic Road, Trollstigen and Geirangerfjord
road_trips.summary: Bridges over the sea, a 'troll's ladder' of hairpins and one of the world's great fjords.
road_trips.tip: Mountain roads open only in summer; ferries run to schedule.

road_trips.name: Lofoten Islands (E10)
road_trips.best_time: June to August; February to March for aurora
road_trips.summary: A road of fishing villages and jagged peaks above the Arctic Circle.
road_trips.tip: Winter driving can be icy; midnight sun lasts from late May to July.

road_trips.name: North Cape Road
road_trips.summary: Across Lapland to the northernmost point of mainland Europe.
road_trips.tip: Reindeer wander on the road; distances between fuel stops can be long.

road_trips.name: Portugal's N2
road_trips.best_time: April to June; September to October
road_trips.summary: Portugal's answer to Route 66, running the length of the country on one road.
road_trips.tip: A slow, winding road, so allow time and book places in small villages.

road_trips.name: Route Napoleon
road_trips.summary: Follow Napoleon's 1815 return from exile through Provence and the Alps.
road_trips.tip: Mountain passes can be icy outside summer.

road_trips.name: Andalusia's White Villages
road_trips.best_time: March to May; September to October
road_trips.summary: Whitewashed hill towns and cave-houses in the mountains of Cadiz and Malaga.
road_trips.tip: Narrow village streets are hard to drive; park outside and walk.

road_trips.name: Peloponnese Loop
road_trips.best_time: April to June; September to October
road_trips.summary: Ancient sites, castles and coastal villages south of Athens.
road_trips.tip: Midsummer heat is intense; plan sightseeing for mornings.

road_trips.name: Georgian Military Road
road_trips.summary: A historic road through the Greater Caucasus to the foot of Mount Kazbek.
road_trips.tip: Snow and landslides can close the road, so check conditions.

road_trips.name: Turquoise Coast (D400)
road_trips.best_time: April to June; September to October
road_trips.summary: A winding coast road between pine-covered mountains and clear Mediterranean bays.
road_trips.tip: Roads are winding and busy in summer.

road_trips.name: Albanian Riviera (SH8)
road_trips.summary: A mountain road above the Ionian Sea with hidden beaches.
road_trips.tip: Mountain bends are tight; take care with passing.

road_trips.name: Kotor Serpentine to Lovcen and Cetinje
road_trips.summary: A road with 25 hairpin bends climbing above the Bay of Kotor.
road_trips.tip: The road is narrow; avoid driving in thick fog.

road_trips.name: Vrsic Pass and the Soca Valley
road_trips.summary: Slovenia's highest road pass leads to the emerald Soca River.
road_trips.tip: The old stone-paved hairpins are steep; snow closes the pass in winter.

road_trips.name: Troodos Mountains Drive
road_trips.summary: Pine forests, wine villages and painted Byzantine churches above the Cyprus coast.
road_trips.tip: Winter snow can close higher roads.

road_trips.name: Karakoram Highway
road_trips.summary: The world's highest paved international road, through the Himalaya, Karakoram and Hindu Kush.
road_trips.tip: Landslides and border-pass closures are common; check permits and current advice.

road_trips.name: Pamir Highway
road_trips.summary: A high road across the roof of the world, among Central Asia's finest mountain scenery.
road_trips.tip: Permits are needed for the Pamir region; altitude is extreme and fuel is scarce.

road_trips.name: Manali-Leh Highway
road_trips.summary: One of the world's highest roads, crossing passes above 5,000 metres in the Himalaya.
road_trips.tip: Open only in summer; altitude sickness is a real risk, so acclimatise.

road_trips.name: Sichuan-Tibet Highway (G318)
road_trips.summary: One of China's most famous drives, through gorges and high plateaus to Lhasa.
road_trips.tip: Foreign visitors need Tibet travel permits and usually a guide.

road_trips.name: Friendship Highway
road_trips.summary: From Lhasa across the Tibetan plateau past Everest to Kathmandu.
road_trips.tip: Permits are required and the border crossing status varies; check current rules.

road_trips.name: Mae Hong Son Loop
road_trips.summary: A loop of mountain curves, Shan villages and misty valleys in northern Thailand.
road_trips.tip: Steep bends need care, especially in the rain; wear a helmet if riding.

road_trips.name: Ha Giang Loop
road_trips.best_time: September to November; March to April
road_trips.summary: Vietnam's most dramatic mountain loop, through limestone karst and rice terraces.
road_trips.tip: Steep, foggy roads; many visitors hire a local rider as driver.

road_trips.name: Hai Van Pass and Central Vietnam Coast
road_trips.summary: A coastal pass through clouds, with beaches and heritage towns at each end.
road_trips.tip: Fog and rain are common at the top of the pass.

road_trips.name: Bolaven Plateau Loop
road_trips.summary: Waterfalls, coffee plantations and minority villages on a cool highland plateau.
road_trips.tip: Roads can be rough after rain.

road_trips.name: Shimanami Kaido
road_trips.best_time: March to May; October to November
road_trips.summary: A string of bridges linking islands across the Seto Inland Sea, loved by drivers and cyclists.
road_trips.tip: Cycling and driving both work; tolls apply for cars.

road_trips.name: King's Highway (Jordan)
road_trips.best_time: March to May; October to November
road_trips.summary: A 3,000-year-old route through biblical sites, crusader castles and canyons to Petra.
road_trips.tip: Roads are good but hilly; plan around summer heat.

road_trips.name: Grand Trunk Road
road_trips.summary: One of Asia's oldest and longest roads, linking Bengal to the Khyber.
road_trips.tip: Border-crossing rules between India and Pakistan are strict; check current advice.

road_trips.name: Mongolia's South Gobi Circuit
road_trips.summary: Camels, dunes, canyons and ger camps across the Gobi Desert.
road_trips.tip: Travel with a 4x4 and driver; roads are tracks and distances are huge.

road_trips.name: Muscat to Sur Coastal Road
road_trips.summary: A coastal road past canyons, sinkholes and turtle beaches.
road_trips.tip: Flash floods are possible in wadis; avoid midday heat.

road_trips.name: Silk Road in Uzbekistan
road_trips.best_time: April to June; September to October
road_trips.summary: Blue-tiled madrasas, caravanserais and desert fortress cities.
road_trips.tip: Train and shared taxi also link the cities if you prefer not to drive.

road_trips.name: Sri Lanka Cultural Triangle and Hill Country
road_trips.summary: Ancient cities, tea country, scenic railway and a colonial fort by the sea.
road_trips.tip: Mountain roads are slow; use a driver if you are not used to local traffic.

road_trips.name: Taiwan East Coast (Route 11)
road_trips.summary: A Pacific coast road with sea cliffs, rice fields and Indigenous culture.
road_trips.tip: Typhoons can close roads from July to October.

road_trips.name: Trans-Flores Highway
road_trips.summary: Volcanoes, rice terraces, traditional villages and a tri-coloured crater lake on Flores.
road_trips.tip: Roads are winding and slow; allow a day for every 100 km.

road_trips.name: Issyk-Kul Loop
road_trips.summary: A circuit around a vast alpine lake in the Tian Shan mountains.
road_trips.tip: Lake weather can be windy; carry cash.

road_trips.name: Garden Route
road_trips.summary: A stretch of coast with lagoons, forests, beaches and wildlife.
road_trips.tip: Park fees apply; book coastal stays early in December and January.

road_trips.name: Panorama Route
road_trips.summary: Escarpment viewpoints, waterfalls and the world's third-largest canyon.
road_trips.tip: Mist can hide views, so go early in the morning.

road_trips.name: Route 62
road_trips.summary: A quirky road through wine valleys, Karoo towns and mountain passes.
road_trips.tip: Fuel and services are limited between towns; summers are hot.

road_trips.name: Namibia Classic Loop
road_trips.summary: Red dunes, ghost towns, rock art and one of Africa's best game parks.
road_trips.tip: Mostly gravel; carry spare tyres, water and plan fuel stops.

road_trips.name: Cairo to Cape Town
road_trips.summary: The great African overland, from the pyramids to Table Mountain.
road_trips.tip: Sections in Sudan and parts of Ethiopia are unsafe at the moment; many overlanders skip them by sea or air. Check current advice.

road_trips.name: Marrakech to the Sahara
road_trips.best_time: March to May; October to November
road_trips.summary: Over the Atlas Mountains past kasbahs to the dunes of Erg Chebbi.
road_trips.tip: Mountain roads have bends and rock falls; avoid summer heat.

road_trips.name: Tanzania Northern Safari Circuit
road_trips.best_time: June to October; January to February
road_trips.summary: A classic safari loop through four famous parks.
road_trips.tip: Most visitors travel with an operator; park fees and vehicle rules apply.

road_trips.name: Madagascar's RN7
road_trips.summary: The island's main road through highlands, rainforests and canyons to the south-west coast.
road_trips.tip: Road quality varies and the trip is slow; many visitors hire a driver.

road_trips.name: Ethiopia's Historic Route
road_trips.summary: A journey through medieval churches, castles and ancient obelisks.
road_trips.tip: Security conditions differ by region and many governments advise against some areas; check current advice.

road_trips.name: Cairo to the White Desert
road_trips.summary: A desert road from the capital to chalk rock sculptures and camping under stars.
road_trips.tip: Travel with a licensed operator and a permit; carry extra water.

road_trips.name: Great Ocean Road
road_trips.summary: A war-memorial road along Australia's southern coast and its limestone stacks.
road_trips.tip: Sunset crowds at the Twelve Apostles are large; allow time for traffic.

road_trips.name: Stuart Highway
road_trips.summary: The main road across the Australian outback from tropical north to southern coast.
road_trips.tip: Fuel and water stops are far apart; avoid driving at dusk when kangaroos cross.

road_trips.name: Nullarbor Plain (Eyre Highway)
road_trips.summary: Australia's famous treeless plain and a long straight road along the Great Australian Bight.
road_trips.tip: Refuel at every roadhouse; whale season is June to October.

road_trips.name: Pacific Highway (Sydney to Brisbane)
road_trips.summary: A coastal drive past beaches, national parks and surf towns.
road_trips.tip: Holiday weekends bring heavy traffic.

road_trips.name: Cairns to Cape Tribulation
road_trips.summary: Where the rainforest meets the Great Barrier Reef.
road_trips.tip: Crocodiles live in rivers and sea; stinger season runs November to May.

road_trips.name: Gibb River Road
road_trips.summary: A rugged Kimberley road to gorges, waterfalls and swimming holes.
road_trips.tip: 4x4 is needed; the road closes in the wet season.

road_trips.name: Great Eastern Drive (Tasmania)
road_trips.summary: Tasmania's east coast with white beaches and pink granite.
road_trips.tip: Book Freycinet walking and campsites ahead in summer.

road_trips.name: Great Alpine Road
road_trips.best_time: March to May; December to February
road_trips.summary: Victoria's alpine drive through autumn colours and snow country.
road_trips.tip: Snow chains may be required in winter.

road_trips.name: Oodnadatta Track
road_trips.summary: A remote desert track past Lake Eyre and artesian mound springs.
road_trips.tip: Needs a rugged vehicle, spare tyres and plenty of water.

road_trips.name: Milford Road
road_trips.summary: A road through Fiordland National Park to one of the world's most photographed fjords.
road_trips.tip: Avalanche closures can occur; carry chains in winter.

road_trips.name: Southern Scenic Route
road_trips.summary: A wild south coast with waterfalls, sea lions and lighthouses.
road_trips.tip: Weather can be wet and windy even in summer.

road_trips.name: Twin Coast Discovery Route
road_trips.summary: A loop of Northland between the Pacific and Tasman coasts.
road_trips.tip: Driving on Ninety Mile Beach is hazardous; check tide times and rental rules.

road_trips.name: Christchurch to Greymouth via Arthur's Pass
road_trips.summary: Across the Southern Alps to the wild West Coast.
road_trips.tip: Mountain weather can change within minutes.

road_trips.name: Queen's Road (Coral Coast)
road_trips.summary: A coast road across the main island of Viti Levu, past beaches and villages.
road_trips.tip: Roads can flood in heavy rain; take care in villages.
